purpose: Keep future solver/runtime/DOM presentation geometry numerically deterministic without authorizing multi-car gameplay.

canonical_space.name: LEVEL_LOGICAL_SPACE
canonical_space.rule: Legal movement and collision are decided only from Level Data logical coordinates. DOM/CSS viewport coordinates are presentation/evidence and MUST NOT become an independent legality source.

boundary_semantics.reason: The existing visible-movement parity fixture defines edge touch as blocked; retaining exact integer logical geometry prevents Python/JS epsilon drift.

presentation_projection.allowed: A deterministic affine projection from logical board space to CSS pixels for rendering and evidence.
presentation_projection.domrect_role: QA observation only; getBoundingClientRect returns viewport-relative CSS-pixel geometry and may be fractional.
presentation_projection.animation_rule: Use requestAnimationFrame timestamps/delta time for visual progress; frame count MUST NOT define logical displacement or completion.
presentation_projection.hidden_tab_rule: Background/hidden animation suspension MUST NOT mutate logical state or create a different legal-move result.

future_runtime_evidence_required: same Level Data produces identical legal-move decisions before and after viewport resize/orientation change
same Level Data produces identical legal-move decisions across at least two CSS projection scales
blocked tap produces zero logical displacement
legal animation remains inside the visible swept corridor within declared QA tolerance
animation completion snaps to the exact logical terminal state rather than accumulated frame deltas
research_basis: MDN Element.getBoundingClientRect: DOMRect reports viewport-relative CSS-pixel geometry and includes border/padding semantics.
MDN requestAnimationFrame: callbacks generally follow display refresh rate, may pause in background tabs, and timestamp-based progress avoids refresh-rate-dependent animation speed.
MDN scrollTop: modern browser geometry values can be subpixel precise.
forbidden_claims: this contract authorizes P1-008 or multi-car implementation
